structure.unit: Civil Actions; Commencement, Pleadings, and Motions

law.catch_line: Motion to strike defensive pleading in equity and at law; exceptions abolished
law.text: Exceptions to answers for insufficiency are abolished. The test of the sufficiency of any defensive pleading in any suit in equity or action at law shall be made by a motion to strike; if found insufficient, but amendable, the court may allow amendment on terms. If a second pleading is adjudged insufficient, the court may enter such judgment or decree or take such other action that it deems appropriate.
